newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatneft total oil reserves 841 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft total oil reserves 841 mln tonnes.

text.p: Russian oil company AO Tatneft, which is planning to raise capital on U.S. markets, has total proven oil reserves of 841.06 million tonnes, an audit of reserves by U.S. petroleum engineers Miller and Lents said.
The following lists proven reserves as of January 1, 1996, according to the audit, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Thursday:
net reserves oil net reserves gas
Miller and Lents, Ltd, based in Houston, Texas, said Tatneft had produced about 2.6 billion tonnes of oil since starting production in 1943.
Production peaked at 103.7 million tonnes (2.7 million barrels per day) in 1975, and was 24.14 million tonnes (483,000 bpd) in 1995.
Pre-tax profit rose to 2.40 trillion roubles in 1995 from 210.5 billion in 1994, according to Russian accounting standards.
Tatneft is planning an issue of level-three American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and has prepared 1995 accounts to international standards, though the accounts have not yet been released.
Tatneft level-one ADRs are already traded in Berlin and Frankfurt.

The company will hold a roadshow in Western Europe, Britain and the U.S. from November 22 to December 6 to present the issue to investors, broker IFK Solid, which is partly owned by Tatneft, said in a statement.
The government of the autonomous region of Tatarstan owns 41 percent of Tatneft, employees have 41.34 percent and suppliers 3.66 percent.
